project_type: Serverless AWS app (Python Lambda + CDK v2 Python) with a static single-file web front-end. Hackathon submission, ship-live is pass/fail.
language: Python 3 (Lambda handler + CDK app + engine); HTML/CSS/vanilla JS (web).
build_system: AWS CDK v2.1033 (installed globally). CDK app is Python: create a venv in cdk/ and pip install aws-cdk-lib + constructs. No bundler for web (single inline HTML file).
test_framework: None formal. Verification = engine self-check (python3 engine/depth_engine.py), local handler import, and post-deploy curl checks.
build_command: cd cdk && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt && cdk synth
test_command: python3 engine/depth_engine.py  (engine self-check); python3 -c 'import handler' from lambda/ with deps stubbed
verification_instructions: ALWAYS export AWS_PROFILE=simi-ops AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 before any aws/cdk command. Account is 888577033943, region us-east-1, no default region in the profile so it MUST be pinned. After deploy, curl the API /health, /reports, /analyze (demo) and the CloudFront root; all must return 200 with no auth.
snapshot_or_generated_files: lambda/depth_engine.py is a COPY of engine/depth_engine.py produced by deploy (cp). cdk/outputs.json produced by cdk deploy --outputs-file. web/index.html has a __API_URL__ placeholder rewritten at deploy time. None of these need committing for the ship gate.
environment_constraints: AWS profile simi-ops has NO default region: pin AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=us-east-1 everywhere and set CDK env=Environment(account='888577033943', region='us-east-1'). CDK already bootstrapped (CDKToolkit CREATE_COMPLETE). Docker is available but AVOID Docker bundling — the Lambda needs only boto3 (runtime-provided) + stdlib, so use Code.from_asset without bundling. Lambda runtime PYTHON_3_13 (local Python is 3.14; that is only the CDK app version and is fine). Keep secrets out of repo; no hardcoded credentials.
contribution_requirements: Reuse engine/depth_engine.py AS-IS (do not rewrite). The vision LLM returns ONLY pixel coordinates + reference object name; it NEVER outputs a depth in metres. The deterministic engine computes all metres and the trace. Everything must be reachable with NO login.
key_patterns: Bedrock vision via the Converse API: bedrock-runtime.converse(modelId='amazon.nova-lite-v1:0', messages=[{'role':'user','content':[{'image':{'format':'png'|'jpeg','source':{'bytes':raw}}},{'text':prompt}]}], inferenceConfig={'maxTokens':300,'temperature':0.0}); read resp['output']['message']['content'][0]['text']. CONFIRMED working on this account for both nova-lite and nova-pro. Open-Meteo (no key): https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast?latitude={lat}&longitude={lon}&hourly=precipitation&forecast_days=1&timezone=Africa%2FNairobi then sum json['hourly']['precipitation']. HTTP API payload v2.0: route on event['requestContext']['http']['method'] and event['rawPath'].
relevant_files: engine/depth_engine.py (READ FIRST — the locked contract; reuse as-is)
directory_structure: kinga-maji/ root. engine/ has the finished depth_engine.py. lambda/ web/ cdk/ are EMPTY and must be filled. .agents/tasks/kinga-maji-ship/ holds plan + FEAT artifacts.

engine_contract.compute_depth: compute_depth(DepthInput) -> DepthResult{depth_m, reference_object, reference_height_m, submerged_fraction, category_key, category_label, consequence, trace, ok, error}; has .to_dict()
engine_contract.fuse_rainfall: fuse_rainfall(DepthResult, rainfall_mm_next_24h: float) -> RiskResult{base_category, rainfall_mm_next_24h, escalated, final_label, advice, trace}
